fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM79,580. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0057149/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Passed STPM or equivalent with at least a C (NGMP 2.0) in two (2) subjects; OR Passed STAM with Jayyid; OR Passed UEC with at least a B in five (5) subjects; OR Passed Matriculation/Foundation with 2.00 CGPA; OR Diploma with at least 2.00 CGPA; OR Other qualifications recognized as equivalent.
